---
applyTo: ".github/skills/**"
---

# Repository Skills Ownership

Repository skills are optional workflows for work that would bloat always-on instructions.

Keep them outcome-based and grounded in the repository's ODA model.

Do not use a skill to hide responsibilities that belong in always-on guidance or exact automation.

## Follow-Through Triggers

If a change under `.github/skills/**` alters what maintainers should do, update the guidance that teaches when to use that skill.
